prompt.alinti: Someone just leaked the full system prompt from Claude Fable 5.1 and this is nothing like the prompts you've seen. It's over 470,000 characters long, around 8,700 lines and it's the exact instructions Anthropic gives one of the world's most powerful AI models on how to think, plan and get work done. The leak includes the entire prompt with its tools, instructions and behavior rules and it's all sitting in a public GitHub so you can level up your own prompting by seeing exactly how Anthropic describes its tools, limits them and tells the model which one to use, when and how.
By the way, if you want that link, comment FABLE and I'll send it to you directly.
